description.value: Uno Gelato is an artisan gelato and sorbetto shop in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, handcrafting small-batch frozen desserts daily from natural local ingredients including Avalon Dairy milk, fresh fruits, and herbs. The shop is known for a rotating seasonal menu alongside year-round favourites, with gluten-friendly cone options and a dedicated vegan sorbetto lineup. Cyclists on the West Broadway corridor can grab a scoop to go or order delivery, and the shop also offers behind-the-scenes gelato-making classes at this location.
